bagPolicy.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks have implemented a clear bag policy to enhance fan safety and expedite entry. Only clear bags of specific sizes are allowed, with all bags subject to search.
allowed: Clear Bags (Plastic, vinyl or PVC) up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small Clutch Bags/Wallets up to 6.5” x 4.5”
Seat cushions without pockets up to 18” wide
prohibited: Luggage, computer bags, camera bags, briefcases, fanny packs, cinch bags
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags and diaper bags are exceptions.

parking.note: Dodger Stadium parking is in the lots around Chavez Ravine, with general admission around $27-35 in advance (cashless, more at the gate) and preferred lots higher. Off-site Lots 13 and 14 on Stadium Way are about $5 with an uphill walk. The free Dodger Stadium Express bus from Union Station is included with a game ticket; entry gate determines which lots you can reach.

rideshare.note: Uber, the official rideshare partner of the Dodgers, has moved its pickup and drop-off location from Lot 11 to Lot 1. Ubers will now enter through Gate B in an effort to decrease Gate A congestion and increase the speed of arrival and drop off for fans.

concessions.note: Dodger Stadium offers a variety of food and drink options, including classic comfort foods with a modern twist at Bridges Grille, elevated ballpark classics at Cadillac Diner, and crispy, golden goodness at Coop & Kennel Pub. Special offerings include a Bacon Wrapped Hot Dog and Pastrami Fry. The Beer Garden provides a selection of local and popular beers.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: ADA accessible seating. Accessible parking in Lot P near Gates A, B, C. ADA drop-off available. Contact Guest Services.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry permitted with ticket scan at gate.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Top Deck or Main Box Office near Gate B. Opens 2 hrs before event. Photo ID required.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: 6 main entry gates (A–F). Use gate closest to your seating section.
